text:
sam (DR lead): Quick sync — the dry-run this morning surfaced a recurring routing regression when traffic shifts from eu-west to us-west under partial pod loss. Not a full outage but increased restore time and some failed snapshot restores. Need owners + timelines for followups.

anne (SRE): saw the same. latency spikes ~400ms for a 30s window, routing table churn logged.

miguel (EngInfra): digging into kube-proxy+service mesh interplay. hypothesis: weight decay + bgp flap interplay on the egress routers. attaching logs in #eng-network.

kevin (Platform): can we list concrete remediation items? prefer to triage into "short" vs "medium" vs "game-day playbook" items.

sam (DR lead): good call. I'll start a short list here — please reply with owner + ETA.

sam (DR lead): 1) Restore runbook gap: steps for cross-region snapshot fallback are ambiguous (v0.2). owner: ? ETA: ?

anne (SRE): I'll take runbook update. owner: anne. ETA: EOD Friday (2180012900). I'll add explicit command sequences and a verification checklist.

miguel (EngInfra): 2) Routing controller tuning: reduce aggressive weight decay and add dampening on ephemeral BGP adverts. owner: miguel. ETA: next Wed (2180015600) for proposal, rollout next fortnight.

kevin (Platform): 3) Snapshot TTL review and restore retries: observed restores failing when snapshots older than 18h. owner: kevin. ETA: Tuesday (2180014000) for config change + canary.

ops-oncall: 4) Game-day scenario: add a multi-region partial-pod-loss drill to calendar, include failover lead, and signal thresholds. owner: ops-oncall. ETA: schedule by 2026-04-05 (2180100000).

itops-bot: checklist updated: runbook_update (anne) | routing_tuning (miguel) | snapshot_retry (kevin) | game_day (ops-oncall).

sam (DR lead): adding a small test matrix for runbook update — anne please include these checks:
- verify snapshot visibility across regions (eu->us)
- validate restore to a warm cluster with new credentials
- measure RTO and RPO (target RTO < 15m)

anne (SRE): ack. I'll add a validation script and a minimal CI job. snippet I'll include:

```bash
# quick smoke restore (internal test)
rfctl restore --snapshot $SNAP_ID --region us-west-2 --target-cluster dr-test-01 
# wait for pods ready, timeout 900s
rfctl wait --cluster dr-test-01 --ready --timeout 900
```

miguel (EngInfra): for routing tuning, initial conservative patch will be: increase local_preference_hold to 120s, add dampening for flapping prefixes, and instrument histogram for route convergence. I'll post PR with metrics dashboards.

kevin (Platform): noted. for snapshot retries I'll add exponential backoff with 3 retries and surface failure reason to Sentry. will start with a canary that affects 10% of restores.

sam (DR lead): can everyone paste the tracking ticket after you create it? I'll maintain the root tracker. Also want a short postmortem snippet for recurring pattern: "partial-pod-loss + cross-region egress + routing weight decay" as the pattern.

anne (SRE): created ENG-DR-1327 (runbook update). link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-DR-1327

miguel (EngInfra): created ENG-NET-2044 (routing tuning). link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-NET-2044

kevin (Platform): created ENG-OPS-1988 (snapshot retry + telemetry). link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/ENG-OPS-1988

ops-oncall: created OPS-GD-58 (game-day partial-pod-loss drill). link: https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/OPS-GD-58

itops-bot: ENG-DR-1327 | ENG-NET-2044 | ENG-OPS-1988 | OPS-GD-58 — linked to incident 2180009999.

sam (DR lead): timeline check: anne EOD Fri, kevin Tue, miguel Wed (proposal). I'll schedule a 30m sync Thurs to confirm cross-team dependencies. ops-oncall will own game-day scheduling.

anne (SRE): one more ask — add a short prompt set for Redwood Optimize to ensure quantization/serving changes don't affect restore workloads. I'll put that in the runbook.

miguel (EngInfra): will add route convergence SLOs to the Console dashboards (per-region).

kevin (Platform): once ENG-OPS-1988 lands I'll enable canary and post canary metrics in the tracker.

sam (DR lead): thanks all. closing the thread when we have PR links and a confirmed game-day date. :thumbsup:

ops-oncall: confirmed calendar invite sent to #oncall and #incidents for 2026-04-05 16:00 UTC. invite id: OPS-GD-58-INVITE.
